final: SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS rate, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) - (SELECT AVG(group_rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(s2.gbsize / s2.spanmin) AS group_rate FROM scans AS s2 JOIN projects AS p2 ON p2.arcregistry = s2.arcref WHERE s2.gbsize / s2.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s2.arcref, p2.fundflux)) AS excess FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.gbsize / s.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux HAVING AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) > (SELECT AVG(group_rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(s2.gbsize / s2.spanmin) AS group_rate FROM scans AS s2 JOIN projects AS p2 ON p2.arcregistry = s2.arcref WHERE s2.gbsize / s2.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s2.arcref, p2.fundflux)) ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
